items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: we went into a place called the Hi-De-Ho Club. It was just me and Bird and Hampton Hawes, and Dingbod and Roy Porter.

ctx.x: about. I didn't know nothin' about it. I hadn't even heard of Stravinsky. Now, you know where I was. I was a dumb stud when it comes to knowing my own music. But Bird hipped me to a lot of things I didn't know about.
But anyway, after we got Bird out of Camarillo, we went into a place called the Hi-De-Ho Club. It was just me and Bird and Hampton Hawes, and Dingbod and Roy Porter.
